decision.explanation: Both Alytus (Lithuania) and Brest (France) are administrative bodies twinned with Cádiz (Spain), as confirmed by direct statements in the provided documents. D1S1 and D1S2 describe the sister city relationship between Alytus and Cádiz, while D2S1 and D2S2 confirm the twinning between Brest and Cádiz. These are distinct valid referents and complementary answers.
